prompt: Our art club has almost (many / students) the evening cooking class.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым существительным во множественном числе (students) для сравнения количества используется конструкция as many + существительное + as.

prompt: My pocket torch isn't nearly (bright) Dad's big camping lamp.
explanation_ru: Карманный фонарик светит намного слабее; после отрицания с nearly используется конструкция as … as (допустимо и so … as).

prompt: The school play practice lasted almost (long) the real evening show.
explanation_ru: Чтобы сравнить длительность двух событий с модификатором almost, используется наречие long в конструкции as long as.

prompt: Can that folding table hold heavy books, or isn't it ___ the wooden one?
explanation_ru: Для сравнения в отрицательном вопросе нужна пара as … as (или so … as). Типичная ошибка — смешивать as/so с союзом than.

prompt: Declan's grey parcel is so heavy as the yellow one on the table.
answer: Declan's grey parcel is as heavy as the yellow one on the table.
accepted_answers: Declan's grey parcel is as heavy as the yellow one on the table.
explanation_ru: В утвердительном предложении нельзя использовать so … as — правильная форма для сравнения равенства всегда as … as.

prompt: We looked at four rooms in a small hotel near the beach. The first three rooms faced the busy road. The back room isn't nearly (noisy) the front ones, and it costs (same / price) them. We took the key straight away.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске отрицательное сравнение с nearly требует as noisy as (или so noisy as), а во втором для совпадения цены используется the same price as.

prompt: Everyone in the office felt relieved because the final repair bill wasn't quite (high) the builder's first guess.
explanation_ru: Счёт оказался немного ниже ожидаемого, поэтому после wasn't quite используется конструкция as high as (или so high as).

prompt: Our new washing machine works quietly and doesn't use nearly (much / water) the old one on a short cycle.
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым существительным water в отрицательном сравнении используется конструкция as much water as (допустимо и so much water as).

prompt: "Was the second wildlife programme boring?" "Not at all — it held our attention almost (well) the first one."
explanation_ru: С глаголом held нужно наречие well; для значения «почти так же хорошо, как» используется модель almost as well as.

prompt: I tried sitting in my old dining chair all afternoon, and it is nowhere near ___ my new desk chair.
explanation_ru: После усиления nowhere near («далеко не…») требуется полная конструкция as + прилагательное + as. Ошибка — пропускать первое as или использовать сравнительную степень с than.

prompt: The autumn photography course is slightly more expensive than the summer one. → The summer photography course isn't quite …
answer: The summer photography course isn't quite as expensive as the autumn one.
accepted_answers: The summer photography course isn't quite as expensive as the autumn one.
The summer photography course isn't quite so expensive as the autumn one.
The summer photography course is not quite as expensive as the autumn one.
The summer photography course is not quite so expensive as the autumn one.
The summer photography course isn't quite as expensive as the autumn photography course.
The summer photography course is not quite as expensive as the autumn photography course.
explanation_ru: Небольшая разница (slightly more expensive) при перестройке в отрицание передаётся конструкцией isn't quite as/so expensive as.

prompt: Oksana chose the west walkway at the station because the east corridor takes much longer to walk through.
options: The east corridor isn't as long as the west walkway.
The west walkway is twice as long as the east corridor.
The west walkway isn't as long as the east corridor.
The west walkway is the same length as the east corridor.
explanation_ru: Если восточный коридор длиннее, значит западный переход не такой длинный, как восточный: isn't as long as.

prompt: We hurried to the bus stop, but the queue was the same length like Friday's, so we missed the coach.
answer: We hurried to the bus stop, but the queue was the same length as Friday's, so we missed the coach.
accepted_answers: We hurried to the bus stop, but the queue was the same length as Friday's, so we missed the coach.
explanation_ru: После the same всегда используется союз as, а не like (the same like — частая калька с русского «такой же, как»).

prompt: Tariq visited the new library wing on Saturday morning to prepare for his driving test. Wheelchairs can reach the upstairs desks almost (easily) the ground-floor entrance. Inside, the study rooms are far (quiet) the noisy hall by the main doors. The clean wooden tables look very (similar) the ones in the college reading room.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске с глаголом reach и модификатором almost нужно наречие as easily as, во втором после усилителя far — сравнительная степень quieter than, а в третьем после similar ставится предлог to.

prompt: Our football club moved its matches to a field on higher ground this autumn. After heavy storms, the new pitch doesn't flood nearly (often) the riverside field did. The dry grass feels completely (different) the muddy ground we used before. Getting there by bike takes (twice / long), yet nobody wants to move back.
explanation_ru: В отрицании с наречием частоты используется as often as, после different нужен предлог from (или to), а для значения «вдвое дольше» — устойчивое сочетание twice as long.

prompt: Thanks to local shopkeepers covering half the bills, the youth centre doesn't need nearly (much / support) it required last year.
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым существительным support после отрицания с nearly нужна конструкция as much support as (допустимо и so much support as).

prompt: Will Mei's updated plan finish on time, now that it is almost (ambitious) the first draft yet gives us (twice / many / days) the old schedule?
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске модификатор almost требует as ambitious as, а во втором кратное сравнение с исчисляемым существительным days строится по модели twice as many days as.

prompt: To Kamil's surprise, the outside advisor reached ___ our own team, even though her summary of the figures was far more detailed.
explanation_ru: Конструкция полного совпадения требует артикля the и союза as: the same conclusion as. Типичные ошибки — опускать the или ставить like / than вместо as.

prompt: Folake prefers a step-by-step change to the timetable because an overnight switch would feel almost as chaotic that our previous office move.
answer: Folake prefers a step-by-step change to the timetable because an overnight switch would feel almost as chaotic as our previous office move.
accepted_answers: Folake prefers a step-by-step change to the timetable because an overnight switch would feel almost as chaotic as our previous office move.
explanation_ru: В конструкции равенства после первого as нельзя ставить that — второй частью пары всегда является союз as (almost as chaotic as).

prompt: Mateo tested the pocket edition of the coastal walking guide during a four-day hike in Wales. Its small maps mark every footpath almost (accurately) the thick handbook does. Because the pocket book is (half / heavy) the hardback version, it fits easily into a coat pocket. It does contain (few / photos) the full guide, yet visitors rarely miss them on the trail.
explanation_ru: С глаголом mark используется наречие as accurately as, для кратного сравнения веса — half as heavy as, а с исчисляемым существительным photos — сравнительная форма fewer photos than.

prompt: Ravi compared the final river-water report with the early summary published in spring. The new team checked every sample almost (carefully) the first group did, and they worked from (same / maps) the university lab. However, the new archive is completely (different) the open website we used before, because visitors now have to book a desk in advance. That single rule has slowed down everyone's work.
explanation_ru: С глаголом checked требуется наречие as carefully as, для совпадения материалов — the same maps as, а после прилагательного different ставится предлог from (или to).
